wa_the_tempest.notes: Cracks and a corner past a small tree, up and right to a ledge belay below the obvious roof.
'Colchuck Reality': up a finger crack to the roof, out the crack, turn the lip, and 12 more feet to the belay ledge — the aid line's namesake pitch, later freed at 5.12d.
Move right on flakes and knobs into a wonderful dihedral; can rope-stretch all the way to a big treed ledge.
Easier ground on runout chickenheads to the base of a treed ledge, just left of a right-facing corner/pillar.
Up the corner to the top of the pillar, then move right into a cave/alcove.
Splitter cracks up the headwall; a flaring slot leads to a pull into a splitter 0.75-inch left-facing corner.
Continuation of the splitter headwall crack system.
A short chimney back and left to an even better ledge.
Simulclimb blocky ground up and left to the summit, finishing with the boulder problem shared by the crag's other lines.

wa_roan_wall_stage_right.notes: Ascend the pale slab, clipping 3 bolts, then angle left with uniquely positive holds; step right around the blind arete to the bolted anchor.
Up a bit, then right on the obvious ledge to belay at the base of the main slab.
Nice face pitch right and up past a 10a friction crux; 9 bolts.
Shortish pitch up a small corner then right to belay; 4 bolts.
Sustained face pitch stepping right then up, weaving around small corners and features; 8 bolts.
Angle left for three bolts then step right across a shallow corner to a knobby section; 9 bolts.
Another full pitch of classic slabbing with crimpy holds; 8 bolts.
Angle backs off for a unique final pitch: an overlap with a 4-inch crack (bolt above), step left past a small tree to an awkward 5.8 ramp/crack, low-angle face, then an easy off-width to the belay.
